definitions.gloss: highest grade; top quality; finest; premium
definitions.explanation: The very best quality or grade of something. Used for products, materials, services, and experiences.

examples.japanese: {最高級|さいこうきゅう}のホテルに{泊|と}まる。
examples.english: To stay at a top-quality hotel.

examples.japanese: この{店|みせ}は{最高級|さいこうきゅう}の{素材|そざい}だけを{使|つか}っている。
examples.english: This shop uses only the finest ingredients.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{最高級|さいこうきゅう}のワインをコレクションしていて、{特別|とくべつ}な{日|ひ}にしか{開|あ}けない。
examples.english: He collects the finest wines and only opens them on special occasions.

notes:
Compound of {最|さい} (most) + {高級|こうきゅう} (high-grade, luxury). Literally "the most high-grade" — the superlative form of {高級|こうきゅう}.

USAGE:
Used as a noun modifier with の ({最高級|さいこうきゅう}の) to describe premium products, services, or experiences. Common in advertising, product descriptions, and restaurant reviews. Can also be used as a standalone noun meaning "the highest grade."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最高級|さいこうきゅう}の{素材|そざい} — finest materials/ingredients
- {最高級|さいこうきゅう}ブランド — top luxury brand
- {最高級|さいこうきゅう}ホテル — top-class hotel
- {最高級|さいこうきゅう}{品|ひん} — premium product

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {高級|こうきゅう} — high-grade, upscale (without the superlative)
- {最上級|さいじょうきゅう} — superlative (grammatical term); also "highest grade" in some contexts
- {一流|いちりゅう} — first-rate, top-tier (focuses on prestige and reputation)
